en: Vintage illustrated postcard featuring a costumed stage actress in a long red and white robe, pointing outward in a dramatic pose. She wears a large white hat with a feather. The border has decorative flowers in the corners. The top text reads "THEATRO DA TRINDADE" and below the figure is the name "THEREZA TAVEIRA", followed by Portuguese text describing her role in a theatrical revue titled "O PAIZ DO VINHO". The printer credit at the bottom mentions Lisbon.
